method: Manual source/quantifier/polarity comparison informed by whole-baseline and pairwise retrieval. Earlier source receipts and the final source-alias and high-relationship pass are combined; no similarity threshold certifies uniqueness.
scope_comparisons: Q4810/Q4811/Q4817 share a Voronoi model but ask amenability, indistinguishability and uniqueness respectively.
Q4819 asks normalized multivariable flat-arrow polynomial realization, whereas Q123 asks J and enhanced J polynomial realization.
Q4822/Q4823 preserve distinct conjugate-point versus Anosov targets, including their differing genus domains; Q4824/Q4825 use different magnetic versus damped-thermostat curvature predicates.
Q4840/Q4841 separate absence of unipotents from the stronger quasi-isometric orbit-map target.
Q4858/Q4859/Q4860 share division-ring definitions but quantify different full group families and conclusions; source scope receipts preserve these distinctions.
Q4897/Q4899 distinguish a nonprincipal lower ultrafilter from specifically Lebesgue/Baire lower ultrafilters; the weak RK/maximal targets were instead mapped to Q1370/Q1371 before publication.
Q4902/Q4909 distinguish all constant-cost communication matrices from XOR lifts; Q4908 approximate Fourier-coset structure is another predicate.

Q4917 is a qualified possible counterexample G equivalent to G*Z (with a weaker theory alternative); Q4918 is unrestricted elementary invariance across finitely generated pairs. Q1618 quasi-isometry and Q2327 automorphisms concern other equivalence notions.
Q4933/Q4934 distinguish existence of finite Artin asymptotic dimension from a specific clique-number bound; Q5048 asks an action classification rather than either bound.
Q4941/Q4945 separate all Kahler subgroups from specified abelian-quotient kernels. Q4946/Q4947 use critical versus supercritical fugacity regimes.
Q4950/Q4951/Q4952 separate closure regularity, existence of a nonclosed leaf with dense periods and general saturated invariant-set classification.
Q4959–Q4963 retain closed-neighbourhood domination versus total domination, general minimum-degree-two versus traceable classes, exact extremizers versus asymptotic/additive constants.
Q4964–Q4978 preserve distinct local large-cardinal hypotheses, normal-measure/embedding/HOD conclusions and conditional UA domains; source aliases Q80–Q84 ask different targets.
Q4982 is a general tree-copy count rule; Q4983/Q4984 are separately posed exact prescribed-distance special-tree targets, not duplicate statements of that rule.
Q4988/Q4989/Q4990 separate eventual product extremizers, flatness-loss equality and exact large-k fixed-d extremal values.
Q4991/Q4992 are homeomorphism invariance of a smooth tautological ring versus examples with positive ring dimension but no connected Lie symmetry.
Q4999/Q5000 are cone confinement and ends of the directed DLA cluster. Q5006/Q5007 are subgroup inheritance versus the Kazhdan-plus-unitarizable compactness conclusion.
Q5010/Q5011 separate holonomy lattice classification from connected components of finite-character leaves.
Q5012/Q5013 are disconnected three-dimensional Kakeya placements versus a classification of shapes connected in every container.
Q5014/Q5015/Q5016 separate nearly linear exact all-start shuffles, sharp all-pair shuffle order and positive-probability reachability networks.
Q5022/Q5023/Q5024 retain distinct structural weak-cop-win, evacuation-to-local-constructibility and repeated-return quantifiers; the common-strategy clarification was independently checked.
Q5026/Q5027 are tiling decision versus existence of a nonperiodically tileable single polyomino.
Q5030/Q5031 distinguish many long lines at all k,l from one four-point line at three colors and large total size.
Q5032/Q5033/Q5034 distinguish a sharp same-ground nonconstant map assertion, arbitrary unbounded codomain classification and bijections of same-ground subsets.
Q5036/Q5037/Q5039 are all-finite rank-plus-one Nielsen connectivity, infinite Grigorchuk rank-three connectivity and finite Gupta-Sidki class-count divergence. Q1411 uses a generating-vertex graph.
Q5040 asks exponential growth with all maximal subgroups normal; Q5041 asks intermediate word growth for one specified regular-tree recursion.

Q5042 compares an arbitrary mixed-sign equation guarantee with circle density; Q1959/Q1961 concern fixed cube configurations. The broader arbitrary-system literal source conjecture is separately refuted and excluded.
Q5043/Q5044 share p(k) but ask a constant leading asymptotic versus every adjacent-integer monotonicity inequality; the new periodic-factor theorem does not decide either.
Q5045 repeated triangle stop-game duration is distinct from one-stage variable-bias Q4329 and computational winner-decision Q4028.
Q5046/Q5047/Q5048 concern automaticity of CAT(0) groups, virtual cocompact Coxeter cubulation and proper Artin cubulation. Shared geometric definitions do not equate these scopes.
Q5049 asks an integral norm property from cut-group edge transitivity; Q4994 graph-automorphism fixed points and Q2931 median-Cayley virtual specialness have different predicates.
limitations: Bounded dated reviews, not a universal certificate of openness or uniqueness.
